cover_headline: Congressman-Elect Amish Shah Puts Tariffs and Anti-Indian Hate at Top of His Agenda
facts: Shah won Arizona's 1st Congressional District with 52.4% of the vote to Republican Jay Feely's 45.4%
He is the first South Asian American to represent Arizona in the US Congress
He plans to join the India Caucus, which will have six members when the new Congress sits

quote.text: Rolling back those tariffs, reasserting Congress's authority over tariffs, and taking it away from the White House will be a top priority as well. We want to help all the small businesses, including all the ones in my district.
quote.speaker: Amish Shah

end.headline: Congressman-Elect Amish Shah Puts Tariffs and Anti-Indian Hate at Top of His Agenda
end.line: Shah, the first South Asian American elected to Congress from Arizona, takes office on January 3.
